Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
# The name of the workflow
name: CI

# Specifies the events that trigger the workflow
on:
  push:
    branches: [ jazzy, main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ jazzy, main ]

# Defines a set of jobs to be run as part of the workflow
jobs:
  # The name of the job
  ROS_CI:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        ros_distribution:
          # - humble
          - jazzy
          - kilted
          - lyrical
        include:
          # ROS 2 Humble Hawksbill
          # - docker_image: ubuntu:jammy
          #   ros_distribution: humble
          #   ros_version: 2
          # ROS 2 Jazzy Jalisco
          - docker_image: ubuntu:noble
            ros_distribution: jazzy
            ros_version: 2
          # ROS 2 Kilted
          - docker_image: ubuntu:noble
            ros_distribution: kilted
            ros_version: 2
          # ROS 2 Lyrical
          - docker_image: ubuntu:resolute
            ros_distribution: lyrical
            ros_version: 2
    container:
      image: ${{ matrix.docker_image }}
    steps:
      - name: Setup workspace
        run: mkdir -p ros_ws/src

      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: ros_ws/src

      - name: Setup ROS environment
        uses: ros-tooling/setup-ros@v0.7
        with:
          required-ros-distributions: ${{ matrix.ros_distribution }}

      - name: Check and Install ROS dependencies
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -e
          source /opt/ros/${{ matrix.ros_distribution }}/setup.bash
          echo "--- Updating rosdep definitions ---"
          rosdep update
          echo "--- Installing system dependencies for ROS 2 ${{ matrix.ros_distribution }} ---"
          rosdep install --from-paths ros_ws/src --ignore-src -y -r --rosdistro ${{ matrix.ros_distribution }} --skip-keys "dynamixel_hardware_interface robotis_interfaces"
          echo "--- Performing rosdep check for ROS 2 ${{ matrix.ros_distribution }} ---"
          if rosdep check --from-paths ros_ws/src --ignore-src --rosdistro ${{ matrix.ros_distribution }} --skip-keys "dynamixel_hardware_interface robotis_interfaces"; then
            echo "--- rosdep check passed ---"
          else
            echo "--- rosdep check failed: Missing system dependencies or unresolvable keys. ---"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Build and Test
        uses: ros-tooling/action-ros-ci@v0.4

        with:
          target-ros2-distro: ${{ matrix.ros_distribution }}
          colcon-defaults: |
            {"test": {"python-testing": "pytest"}}
          vcs-repo-file-url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ROBOTIS-GIT/open_manipulator/${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}/open_manipulator_ci.repos"
          package-name: |
            open_manipulator
            open_manipulator_bringup
            open_manipulator_collision
            open_manipulator_description
            open_manipulator_gui
            open_manipulator_moveit_config
            open_manipulator_playground
            open_manipulator_teleop
            om_gravity_compensation_controller
            om_joint_trajectory_command_broadcaster
            om_spring_actuator_controller

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
